an10.95:1.1: Atha kho Uttiyo paribbājako yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
an10.95:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Uttiyo paribbājako Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an10.95:1.3: ‘kin nu kho bho Gotama sassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan' ti?
an10.95:1.5: sassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan' ti.
an10.95:2.1: ‘Kiṃ pana bho Gotama asassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan' ti?
an10.95:2.3: asassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan' ti.
an10.95:3.1: ‘Kin nu kho bho Gotama antavā loko . . .
an10.95:3.7: hoti ca na ca hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā . . .
an10.95:3.8: neva hoti na na hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan' ti?
an10.95:3.10: neva hoti na na hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan' ti. 2.
an10.95:4.1: ‘Kin nu kho bho Gotama sassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan' ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘avyākataṃ kho etaṃ Uttiya mayā:
an10.95:4.2: sassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan' ti vadesi.
an10.95:5.1: ‘Kiṃ pana bho Gotama asassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan' ti iti puṭṭho samāno
an10.95:5.2: ‘etam pi kho Uttiya avyākataṃ mayā: asassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan' ti vadesi.
an10.95:6.1: ‘Kin nu kho bho Gotama antavā loko . . .
an10.95:6.7: hoti ca na ca hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā . . .
an10.95:6.8: neva hoti na na hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan' ti iti puṭṭho samāno
an10.95:6.10: neva hoti na na hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan' ti vadesi.
an10.95:7.1: ‘Abhiññāya kho ahaṃ Uttiya sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desemi sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyā' ti.
an10.95:8.1: ‘Yaṃ pan' etaṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo abhiññāya sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesi sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya, sabbo ca tena loko niyyissati upaḍḍho vā tibhāgo vā' ti?
an10.95:9.1: Atha kho āyasmato Ānandassa etad ahosi
an10.95:9.2: ‘mā h' evaṃ kho Uttiyo paribbājako pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭilabhati:
an10.95:9.3: sabbasāmukkaṃsikaṃ vata me samaṇo Gotamo pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti no vissajjeti na nūna visahatī ti,
an10.95:9.4: tad assa Uttiyassa paribbājakassa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā' ti.
an10.95:10.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Uttiyaṃ paribbājakaṃ etad avoca:-- 4.
an10.95:10.2: ‘Tena h' āvuso Uttiya upaman te karissāmi,
an10.95:10.3: upamāyam idh' ekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
an10.95:10.4: Seyyathā pi āvuso Uttiya rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷhuddāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ ekadvāraṃ.
an10.95:10.5: Tatr' assa dovāriko paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā,
an10.95:10.6: so tassa nagarassa samantā anupariyāyapathaṃ anukkamamāno na passeyya pākārasandhiṃ vā pākāravivaraṃ vā antamaso biḷāranissakkanamattaṃ pi,
an10.95:10.7: no ca khvāssa evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti ‘ettakā pāṇā imaṃ nagaraṃ pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā' ti.
an10.95:10.8: Atha khvāssa evam ettha hoti ‘ye kho keci oḷārikā pāṇā imaṃ nagaraṃ pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā, sabbe te iminā dvārena pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā' ti. Evam
an10.95:11.1: eva kho āvuso Uttiya na Tathāgatassa evaṃ ussukkataṃ hoti ‘sabbo ca tena loko niyyissati upaḍḍho vā tibhāgo vā' ti.
an10.95:11.2: Atha kho evam ettha Tathāgatassa hoti ‘ye kho keci lokamhā niyyiṃsu vā niyyanti vā niyyissanti vā, sabbe te pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittā satta bojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā
an10.95:11.3: evam ete lokamhā niyyiṃsu vā niyyanti vā niyyissanti vā' ti.
an10.95:11.4: Yad eva kho tvaṃ āvuso Uttiya Bhagavantaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi, tad eva taṃ pañhaṃ Bhagavantaṃ aññena pariyāyena apucchi.
an10.95:11.5: Tasmā te taṃ Bhagavā na vyākāsī
